# Look at interiors of each block: which blocks contain OTHER object colors inside them?
def interior_blocks(I):
    h=len(I); w=len(I[0]); seen=set(); B=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            c=I[i][j]
            if c==0 or (i,j) in seen: continue

            while st:
                a,b=st.pop()
                if (a,b) in seen or I[a][b]!=c: continue
                seen.add((a,b)); comp.append((a,b))

                    if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and I[x][y]==c: st.append((x,y))
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            R=max(rs)-min(rs)+1; C=max(cs)-min(cs)+1
            # interior cells (not on bbox edge)

            B.append(dict(c=c,n=len(comp),R=R,C=C,interior=len(inter),foreign=foreign,border=border))
    return B
